title: PracticePay Patient Financing Payoff Good-Through Period and Returned Payments
content:
**Rule.** The good-through period of a PracticePay Patient Financing payoff follows the plan's returned-payment record: two or more returned-payment entries on the plan dated within the last 6 months give 10 days, exactly one gives 5 days, and none gives 2 days. Here a window of the last 6 or 12 months covers entries dated fewer than that many whole months before today, a month being whole once today's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

| Returned-payment entries on the plan within the last 6 months | Good-through days |
|---|---|
| none | 2 |
| exactly one | 5 |
| two or more | 10 |


## Edge of the window (hypothetical dates, payoff on 15 October)

| Return dated | Whole months before 15 October | Within the last 6 months |
|---|---|---|
| 16 April | 5 (the 15th has not reached the 16th) | yes |
| 15 April | 6 | no |
| 14 April | 6 | no |
| 15 October (today) | 0 | yes |

A plan whose returns are dated 1 May and 20 September, with a payoff on 15 October, shows two within the last 6 months and takes 10 good-through days.
